', 'title': 'جاهزين للّمة؟', 'text': 'The Village Villas – Dead Sea | Villa 1'}];
let i=0;
const img=document.getElementById('gImg'), title=document.getElementById('gTitle'), text=document.getElementById('gText');
const btitle=document.getElementById('gBottomTitle'), btext=document.getElementById('gBottomText'), count=document.getElementById('gCount');
const thumbs=document.getElementById('thumbs'), dots=document.getElementById('dots');
function render(){
 const g=gallery[i]; img.style.opacity=.35;
 setTimeout(()=>{img.src=g.src;img.alt=g.title;title.textContent=g.title;text.textContent=g.text;btitle.textContent=g.title;btext.textContent=g.text;count.textContent=i+1;img.style.opacity=1;},90);
 document.querySelectorAll('.thumb').forEach((x,n)=>x.classList.toggle('active',n===i));
 document.querySelectorAll('.dot').forEach((x,n)=>x.classList.toggle('active',n===i));
 const active=document.querySelector('.thumb.active'); if(active) active.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest',inline:'center'});
}
gallery.forEach((g,n)=>{
 const t=document.createElement('button'); t.className='thumb'; t.innerHTML='<img src="'+g.src+'" alt="">'; t.onclick=()=>{i=n;render()};
 thumbs.appendChild(t);
 const d=document.createElement('span'); d.className='dot'; d.onclick=()=>{i=n;render()}; dots.appendChild(d);
});
document.getElementById('prev').onclick=()=>{i=(i+1)%gallery.length;render()};
document.getElementById('next').onclick=()=>{i=(i-1+gallery.length)%gallery.length;render()};
let startX=0;
img.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>startX=e.touches[0].clientX,{passive:true});
img.addEventListener('touchend',e=>{const dx=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-startX;if(Math.abs(dx)>45){i=dx<0?(i+1)%gallery.length:(i-1+gallery.length)%gallery.length;render()}});
render();
</script>
</body></html>
